fact: The strategy adopted on 18 January 2023 says IMSP has a supercomputer and plans to equip IMSP to use it and to give the existing national data centre a shared AI-as-a-service layer over 9 months.
title: Stratégie Nationale d'Intelligence Artificielle et des Mégadonnées 2023 - 2027
publisher: Ministère du Numérique et de la Digitalisation
